title: Settings

logout.title: Sign out?

notifications.title: Notifications

prejobChecklist.help: New work orders start with these controls. Enable a notification per item and choose its time on the workday before the planned visit.
prejobChecklist.empty: No items yet. Without items a work order cannot be released.

weeklySummary.label: Weekly summary
weeklySummary.sub: An overview by email every Monday

progressReminder.label: Log reminder

security.onDescription: You'll enter a code from your authenticator app each time you sign in.
security.offDescription: Add an extra layer of security with a code from an authenticator app.
security.setupStep1: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
security.setupStep2: Then enter the 6-digit code from the app to confirm.
security.invalidCode: That code didn't match. Try again.
security.disableDescription: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication.

emailChange.title: Change email address
emailChange.subtitle: Enter your new email and current password. We'll send a confirmation link to the new address — your email only changes once you click it.
emailChange.sent: We've sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Your email address changes once you open that link.
